title: Fixed-width r||s ECDSA signatures
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1. QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “For ES256 the COSE signature value is the fixed-width concatenation r || s, 32 bytes each — not the ASN.1 DER encoding”.

statements.label: Fixed-width r||s ECDSA signatures
statements.requirement: ES256 signatures SHALL be carried as 64-byte r||s. The library SHALL convert from and to the ASN.1 DER form returned or expected by platform crypto APIs (JCA, Android Keystore, PKCS#11, RustCrypto). The verifier SHALL reject an ES256 signature that is not exactly 64 bytes.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-COS-005 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-COS-005 an ES256 signature is a fixed-width 64-byte r and s, whatever the signer returns` (SignCoseTest.kt)).
